# HTML&HTML

> HTML&HTML is a bilingual website fix validator and AI implementation mandate platform. It scans public website signals, prioritizes technical findings, and turns them into implementation-ready instructions for AI coding agents.

## Core product

- [Website Fix Validator](https://htmlandhtml.com/): Free public scan for technical SEO, AI/GEO readiness, structured data, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, baseline security headers and selected structural signals.
- Fix Mandate: A site-specific implementation contract containing evidence, priority, target state, implementation instructions, acceptance criteria, regression tests, rollback rules and stop conditions.
- Codebase Mandate: A source-aware version that can target files, components, dependencies and regression surfaces when codebase access is available.

## Pricing

- Free Scan: USD 0.
- Fix Mandate: USD 49 one-time.
- Codebase Mandate: USD 99 one-time.

## Important limitations

- A 100/100 validator score means the measured checks passed; it does not guarantee Google rankings, traffic, AI citations or commercial results.
- Public scanning can verify externally visible behavior but cannot reliably identify the source file that must change. File-level fixes require codebase context.
- The service does not collect payment card information until a production payment provider is connected.

## Languages

- Turkish and English are available on the same canonical application.
